title: Using dimensional reduction for hadronic collisions
claim: DRED can be used for NLO hadronic cross sections: infrared singularity structure shows no factorization problem; DRED is combined with standard PDFs; several DRED versions in the literature differ in IR/factorization behaviour; conversion rules of NLO ingredients from DRED to other schemes are given.
scheme: DRED / FDH variants with epsilon-scalars (details not read).
symmetry_argument: Not a SUSY argument (IR factorization and scheme conversion).
red_flags: Peripheral to SUSY protection; recorded for scheme definitions only.
